name: Tessera TKR-10 'Executor'
description:
The Tessera TKR-10 is a six-shot double-action revolver chambered in 10mm Auto using moon clips, featuring the same biometric grip lock found on all Tessera sidearms. The moon-clip system allows the revolver to fire rimless 10mm Auto cartridges — the same ammunition used in Tessera's TK-20 semi-automatic — simplifying logistics for Tessera security teams that field both weapon types.

The Executor exists because a small but vocal contingent within Tessera's security division insisted on revolvers. Rather than fight the preference, Tessera built a revolver that integrates into their existing ecosystem — same ammunition, same biometric lock, same corponation registration system. The result is a corporate revolver that is as controlled and trackable as any Tessera semi-automatic.

The weapon's performance with 10mm Auto is impressive. The round was originally designed for semi-automatic pistols and produces slightly higher velocity from the revolver's sealed cylinder than from a semi-automatic's breech. Combined with the revolver's inherent accuracy advantages — no moving slide to disturb aim — the Executor shoots tighter groups than most duty semi-automatics at equivalent distances.
specifications:
caliber: 10mm Auto
effective_range: 50 meters
rate_of_fire: Double-action revolver
magazine_capacity: 6 rounds (cylinder, moon clip)
weight: 0.98 kg
tactical_use: A corponation-integrated revolver offering 10mm Auto performance with biometric security. The moon-clip system enables fast reloads approaching semi-automatic speeds. Ammunition compatibility with Tessera's semi-automatic platforms simplifies supply logistics. The biometric lock prevents unauthorized use. The revolver mechanism eliminates feed-related malfunctions.
cultural_context: The Executor is a curiosity — a corporate revolver in an age when revolvers are considered either traditional or eccentric. Within Tessera, the security personnel who carry Executors are viewed with a mixture of respect for their marksmanship preferences and mild amusement at their stubbornness. Outside Tessera, the weapon is proof that the corponation will accommodate even its employees' weapon preferences, provided those preferences are properly registered and tracked.
known_users: Former military personnel in Tessera service
story_hooks: An Executor's biometric lock fails during a security incident, and the investigation reveals that Tessera has been collecting trigger-pull timing data from every biometric weapon they've ever produced — building behavioral profiles of their own security force.
A Tessera security officer uses moon clips loaded with experimental 10mm rounds that shouldn't exist outside Tessera's R&D division. The officer has no memory of receiving them.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sophisticated corporate revolver with refined, angular lines — all business and precision. The TKR-10 reads as expensive and controlled, with a distinctly modern aesthetic that eschews traditional revolver curves in favor of geometric planes and purposeful edges. It's immediately recognizable as a Tessera product.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 24.5 cm | Barrel length: 10.2 cm | Cylinder diameter: 3.8 cm | Grip height: 12.1 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty but balanced — 0.98 kg sits comfortably in the hand with forward bias toward the cylinder, creating inherent stability. Substantial enough to feel serious, not so heavy as to fatigue during extended carry.
physical_description.primary_material: Stainless steel frame and cylinder with polymer grip panels; internal lockwork is hardened steel
physical_description.finish: Brushed stainless steel with matte-black DLC (diamond-like carbon) coating on internal components and trigger mechanism; the cylinder retains a polished satin finish to reduce friction and show the precision moon-clip recesses
physical_description.color_scheme: Silver-gray stainless as primary, with satin-black grip panels featuring subtle Tessera corporate branding; small Φ symbol in matte black on the frame
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer with shallow diamond-pattern crosshatching for positive purchase; warm slightly-rubberized finish that doesn't require gloves but accommodates them
distinctive_features: Six recessed moon-clip seats visible in the cylinder face — precision-machined circular depressions that guide rimless cartridges
Biometric sensor panel flush-integrated into the upper grip panel (backstrap) — thin optical line of ruby-red LEDs (dormant until activated)
Triggerguard has subtle forward curl, aggressive but refined
Top of frame features integral Picatinny rail (compact, 15mm length) for optional reflex sight
Cylinder release button is oversized and textured, positioned in classic L-frame manner
Minimalist iron sights — low-profile front post, adjustable rear notch
Moon-clip ejector rod recessed into frame — no external rod, flush design
Cylinder flutes are shallow and numerous, emphasizing precision manufacturing
Fine horizontal striations on frame sides (deliberate finish, not wear)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: TESSERA CORPORATION etched in small serif font on the left frame flat, above the cylinder; TKR-10 'EXECUTOR' in taller letters on the right frame flat; tiny delta-Φ symbol (corporate logo) stamped near the topstrap, barely visible in normal light; serial number engraved on the frame underside (visible only on disassembly, per Tessera's security policy)
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-grade maintained — brushed finish shows microscopic wear patterns and light handling marks, but no rust or damage; biometric panel is pristine and responsive; cylinder rotates with mechanical smoothness; edges remain sharp; moon-clip recesses are clean and exact; a weapon that is regularly inspected, properly serviced, and carried with professional respect
